query: WITH candidates AS (SELECT tenant,app,event_id FROM app_deliveries WHERE tenant=$1 AND app=$2 AND available_at<=now() AND (state='queued' OR state='running' AND lease_until<now()) ORDER BY event_id LIMIT $4 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE app_deliveries d SET state='running',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=$3,last_attempt_at=now(),lease_until=now()+interval '30 seconds' FROM candidates c WHERE d.tenant=c.tenant AND d.app=c.app AND d.event_id=c.event_id
